verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the landing page's lively visual tone and requires imagery featuring children and a restaurant atmosphere.
The client requires the supplied design reference to be adapted with amendments using the client's product pictures.
The client requires replacement of the first eight images, changing the landing page's rendered visual content; deployment timing is not encoded as an attribute.
The client clarifies that the upper-page photos must be replaced with more attractive images, changing the visual-selection acceptance criterion.
